'''Anemos''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] that makes a sword fire a {{MCW|Wind Charge|wind charge}} with every hit.

== Obtaining ==
* [[Prayer of Aeolus]], a crafted [[blessing]] that also gives Wind Burst I. In 1.12.2 it stores the old <code>main:anemos</code>, which becomes Anemos the first tick the sword is held in the main hand and cannot be applied to copper swords.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/enchantment/anemos.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_anemos.json}}</ref>
* Iron swords in the tower and barracks chests of the [[Abbey]] come with Anemos.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/abbey/tower.json}}</ref>
Anemos has a maximum level of I and cannot appear on random enchanted books.

== Usage ==
Anemos can be applied to wooden, stone, copper, iron, diamond and netherite (adamant) swords, and to sticks. Golden swords and {{MCW|Mace|maces}} cannot take it. Because the Prayer of Aeolus gives the old enchantment in 1.12.2, copper swords cannot get Anemos from it. Its anvil cost multiplier is 0.

== Behavior ==
When the wielder hits a mob, the enchantment runs a function that summons a wind charge in front of the player's eyes (0.75 blocks ahead) and launches it in the direction the player is looking at 2.5 blocks per tick.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/anemos.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/backend/apply_motion.mcfunction}}</ref> The same function is also attached to the enchantment's <code>hit_block</code> effect.

After each wind charge, Anemos has a cooldown of 10 ticks (0.5 seconds), the same as throwing a wind charge; hits during the cooldown fire nothing. The wind charge is owned by the player, so kills with it are credited to the player, and [[Abbey]] advancements that check for the player's wind charges detect it.
